title: Closed etale support kernel and its exact left adjoint
statement: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], with complementary open immersion $j:O\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Work in the abelian categories of abelian sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Use direct images $i_*,j_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and inverse images $i^{-1},j^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For each abelian sheaf $F$ on $X$, define $P_Z(F)=\ker(F\to j_*j^{-1}F)$ using the adjunction unit, and define $i^!_0F=i^{-1}P_Z(F)$. Then the canonical closed adjunction unit induces a natural isomorphism $P_Z(F)\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*i^!_0F$. The functor $i_*:\operatorname{Ab}(Z_{\mathrm{et}})\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{et}})$ is exact and is left adjoint to $i^!_0$: for all abelian sheaves $G$ on $Z$ and $F$ on $X$, there is a natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_X(i_*G,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_Z(G,i^!_0F)$.

source.place: Tag 09XQ, lemma-sections-with-support-acyclic, proof: the support adjunction, supported-sheaf identification and exactness of closed pushforward used there.

proof.text: A closed immersion is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite]. The existing preservesFiniteLimits_lowerStar instance and [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact] supply the two exactness classes.

Evaluate the functor-category kernel at each sheaf F. PreservesKernel.iso for evaluation identifies it with the objectwise kernel sectionsWithSupport AddCommGrpCat j in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.ClosedImmersionUpperShriek. After composing with the kernel inclusion, naturality is exactly naturality of the functor-category kernel inclusion; cancellation proves this is a natural isomorphism e. The existing isZero_upperStar_sectionsWithSupport proves restriction of the objectwise kernel is zero: inverse image preserves kernels and the image of the open unit is invertible by the invertible open counit and the triangle identity. Transport this vanishing along j^*(e_F).

Apply isIso_upperStarLowerStarAdjunction_unit_app_of_isZero from the same existing library module to each supportedKernel(j)(F). Its proof puts a sheaf vanishing on the open complement in the closed essential image [lem-kun-04ca], uses the invertible closed counit [prop-openclosed-lowerstar-fully-faithful] to invert the unit on a closed pushforward, and transfers invertibility by naturality. The resulting pointwise instances make the specified whiskered canonical unit invertible.

Reuse lowerStarClosedUpperShriekAdjunction AddCommGrpCat i j hij from WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.ClosedImmersionUpperShriek, where hij is the equality of the closed image with the complement of the open image obtained from IsCompl.eq_compl. This existing adjunction realizes the original Hom-set argument: j^*i_*G=0 kills the composite with the open unit, so every map i_*G to F factors uniquely through its objectwise kernel; compose with the invertible closed unit and use full faithfulness of i_*. The inverse sends k to i_*k followed by the inverse unit and the kernel inclusion, and kernel uniqueness proves both naturalities. Finally whisker e on the right by i^* and transport the adjunction along its inverse using Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight. Its right adjoint is exactly the unchanged supportedClosedInverseImage i j.

tool_uses.why: The general equivalence between closed etale sheaves and sheaves supported on Z is a generic tool; the Kummer unit contains no such equivalence.
Only the underived open counit isomorphism is used to show the restricted support kernel is zero; no Kunneth or derived Leray assertion is invoked.

The statement matches 09XQ+04CA: an arbitrary closed immersion and Ab(X_et), with no quasi-compact or torsion hypothesis. That generality is correct on the étale site because geometric points off Z factor through O and stalks are conservative. It is unlike the pro-étale def-pur-flasque-support and det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction, which need quasi-compact j and work with different coefficients. Step checks: (1) closed immersion is finite, then f_* is exact on Ab. (2) Kernel functoriality, j^{-1} exact, invertible open counit plus the triangle identity give j^{-1}P_Z=0. (3) Stalk-germ comparison, factoring through O and conservativity give the stalk criterion; lem-kun-04ca's essential-image clause gives P_Z F≅i_*B and j^{-1}i_*G=0. (4) Invertible closed counit (prop-openclosed-lowerstar-fully-faithful; its coefficient category includes Ab), triangle identity and naturality show the canonical unit is iso. (5) Open adjunction plus kernel universal property. (6) Composition with the 04CA full faithfulness; explicit inverses check out. Edge cases Z=X, Z=∅, nonreduced Z and injective F all work.
